stage: Application source 668bf4b was measured against the original deployed baseline. Test-only source 9171e95 has the identical application src tree and passed Release CI, complete Chromium verification and Pages deployment. Its subsequent live online close-camera validation failed with a native Skia allocation abort, so the release is not accepted. Successful CI/deployment facts, measured and deployed artifact identities, and the separate live failure are retained without relabeling the measurements.

environment.protocol: Each stationary scenario runs baseline then candidate. Moving scenarios run baseline/candidate then candidate/baseline (ABBA), in fresh browser processes on the same runner. CPU profiles are collected separately after timing, only in the first repetition.

independent_audit.scope: Independent recomputation from all raw captures and the exported summary rows; numeric relative tolerance1e-12 and absolute tolerance1e-9.

aggregation: Arithmetic mean of the independent per-run metrics; minima/maxima describe repeated runs, not confidence bounds. Stationary cases have one pair. Moving cases have two pairs in ABBA order.
limitations: Main-thread task CPU uses CDP threadTicks and includes the metric interval/probe transfer.
rAF is scheduling cadence; map resolves are submissions. Neither is final display presentation.
SwiftShader is a software GPU; these measurements are not hardware-GPU FPS.
Held-key moving workloads are identical inputs but faster simulation can travel farther; public HUD poses are retained for every run.

Wall-clock timing and moving endpoint differences mean stationary images are the appropriate direct before/after visual comparison. Pixel-window changes are intentional in minified Perspective Pixel façades.
Two timed runs per moving variant and one pair per stationary case do not establish confidence intervals.
Each candidate is compared only with the original baseline measured on the same runner; cross-run timing differences are not attributed to individual follow-up changes.
A moving run contains 30–65 map submissions, so its p95 depends on few tail observations.

The performance artifact contains source 668bf4b measurements, not a benchmark of the 9171e95 acceptance binary. Full application-source equality is verified separately; package/runtime identities remain distinct.
An improvement in the mean of two p95 values does not establish a tail improvement in each repetition. Per-repetition direction and execution order are retained in moving_pair_changes.

The e086 revision passed earlier CI but subsequently failed a live DPR2 close-camera check with OutOfMemoryException. Its benchmark evidence remains intermediate; the added bundled-data regression and synthetic index-pressure fixtures have separate scopes.
The repository preserves audited rows and provenance. Complete raw browser records, screenshots and profiles are in the Actions performance artifact until 2026-12-07T11:33:46Z.

stationary_images.scope: 1200×780 browser PNGs. Map rectangle x0,y60,width1200,height663 excludes toolbar/footer but includes identical stationary HUD overlays. Additional x345,y60,width850,height520 crop excludes upper-left settings HUD and bottom touch controls. Pixel differences are reported, not treated as failures because minified Perspective Pixel windows intentionally change.

cpu_profile_observations.scope: Separate post-measurement profiles, one per selected scenario/variant. Sampled elapsed weights are diagnostic and not the timed CDP thread-CPU measurement. The measured native WASM has no name/custom symbol section, so wasm-function indices are revision-local and cannot be mapped to C# method names or compared as stable method identities.
cpu_profile_observations.grouping: Self samples: (idle), (program), wasm-function names/.wasm URL, selected named WebGL binding functions, (garbage collector), other. Inclusive categories are not added.

record.data: Bundled Manhattan; external tile, imagery, elevation and routing hosts are blocked.

high_dpi_camera_verification.scope: DPR2 input/camera/runtime regression with bundled Manhattan and relief explicitly enabled. This does not reproduce the uncaptured broader live tile set or total live process heap.

regression_traces.retention: These three exact raw JSON files are retained in the repository independently of Actions artifact expiry.

source_equivalence.scope: The full src tree is identical. The only change is the browser test assertion for the actual selected camera option. Assembly metadata and package/runtime identities may differ between builds.

measurement_verification.preceding_verify_failure: The newly added DPR2 test attempted to read the selected value from a closed ComboBox accessibility snapshot, which exposes only its name. The first two close-camera checkpoints and both CPU/GPU immediate-submit journey checks passed; full acceptance follows from the corrected test-only source.

superseded_acceptance_attempts.reason: The test required aria-selected=true on a virtualized option whose initial selection is exposed by the ComboBox aria-activedescendant instead. The actual popup screenshot shows Orbit selected and its ARIA snapshot contains the named Orbit option without selected state. No application source changed in the correction.

failure_audit.failure: The test required aria-selected=true on the already-selected Orbit option. The opened listbox and option exist, but the actual popup AX snapshot contains no selected option state. The screenshot visibly marks Orbit as selected.
failure_audit.scope: Two camera checkpoints passed; horizon traversal, pause/resume/exit and later exploration checks were not reached. This is not full release acceptance.

live_validation.confirmed_failure: Exact WASM disassembly and pinned Skia source identify native allocation failure in sk_malloc_flags, called by SkArenaAlloc::ensureSpace while SkEdgeBuilder::buildPoly allocated edge pointers during SkScan::FillPath CPU rasterization. The runtime then aborted; no managed OutOfMemoryException was logged for this failure.
live_validation.scope: The successful bundled-data CI checks remain valid. This live check used online provider data and native input delivery, whose exact data/input sequence differs from CI and was not fully captured. The configured 2 GiB ceiling is not a measurement that the heap reached that size. Native allocation failure is established; the mechanism of heap exhaustion or growth failure remains under investigation.
